Explain how a VPN works in simple words
8:42 PM

A VPN is a private tunnel between your device and another computer on the internet. Everything you send goes through it scrambled, so people in between, like café Wi-Fi or your internet company, can't read it.

The websites you visit then see the VPN's address instead of yours, so your location looks different. Your internet company can see that you use a VPN, but not what you do inside it.

A VPN doesn't make you invisible. The VPN company can still see your traffic, so pick one you trust.
